seo__browser_title: Used Clothing Store — Oakdene House Foundation
seo__search_description: Free men's and women's clothing, shoes and accessories at Oakdene's Used Clothing Store, inside the Laundrette at 1 Dale Street, Fairfield.
hero__intro: Free clothing for people doing it tough.
intro_details__text: The Oakdene Used Clothing Store offers free men's and women's clothing, shoes, and accessories to people experiencing hardship. The store is located inside our Laundrette at 1 Dale Street, Fairfield.
intro_details__text_2: We believe access to clean, decent clothing is a basic necessity, and we are here to help without judgment.
intro_details__text_3: The same eligibility applies as the Oakdene Kitchen and Laundrette — a current Centrelink Income Statement and photo ID showing income under $1,200 per fortnight.
clothing_images__image_alt: Clothing rack at the Oakdene Used Clothing Store
clothing_images__image_alt_2: Close up view of clothing at Oakdene
also_available_note__text_2: The Oakdene Laundrette and Oakdene Kitchen operate on the same days and hours. You can access all three services on a single visit.
data__guidelines: One person in the room at a time
Access will be managed by the staff onsite
Items are not available by request and based on donations received
